A flying sword is still a sword, and the Vila know their swords. Things shouldn't be this hard or inconvenient...

#### Go to Sadov-Arbat

#### Go check on the situation

**???:** —!

**Paimon:** Huh!? What was that!? Something just zipped right past us!

**Blyushko:** ...*panting*... You two — please, stop that thing! I promise I'll make it worth your while!

- **Traveler:** (Wasn't that Vesna's sword...? We should catch up and find out what's going on.)

#### Pursue the suspicious thief

**Vesna & Paimon:** ...Gotcha!

**Vesna:** Oh! What are you two doing here...?

**Paimon:** Wait... That's your sword! No wonder it looked so familiar!

##### Response branch 1

##### Response branch 2

**Vesna:** See? It's already trying to sneak away.

**???:** —!

**Vesna:** Oh, no you don't. You're staying right there.

**???:** ...!

**Vesna:** Whew, what a day! You two must be exhausted as well, so why don't we leave things here for now? I'll have the missing items returned and your reward delivered later! Right, then! See you around. Bye-bye!

- **Traveler:** Wait!

**Paimon:** Yeah! You can't just run off when we still have no idea what's going on!

- **Traveler:** Why did your sword suddenly start moving on its own?

**Vesna:** Uh...

- **Traveler:** And why did it start stealing things?

**Vesna:** Well...

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** An incident involving the Commander of the Druzhna...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** I wonder who we ought to report it to.

##### Shared continuation

**Vesna:** All right, all right! No need for the interrogation. I'll talk! Heh, with skills like yours, I'm sure the Druzhna's interrogation division could find a place for you...

**Vesna:** Anyway, this part shouldn't come as too much of a surprise. The Ruler of Life's power has an effect on my creations, imbuing each of them with a certain degree of... "spiritual power."

**Paimon:** "Spiritual power"? Huh, honestly, that sounds a bit mystical for Snezhnaya...

**Vesna:** Funny you say that because, a few days ago, I was at a rare book dealer and was able to score — ahem — acquire an ancient manuscript from Liyue.

**Vesna:** It spoke of people in ancient times who cultivated both body and mind until they attained power comparable to that of the adepti.

**Vesna:** Some could even command flying swords, nurture sword spirits, and vanquish monsters and evil beings. Throughout ancient Liyue, they were known as...

**Vesna:** Sword Immortals!

**Paimon:** And you thought... since you have a flying sword already, and are basically a different kind of immortal, you would just... copy whatever that suspicious old book told you to do, and it would work?

**Vesna:** Hehehe, you've got me all figured out! But just imagine, a whole group of sword spirits at my beck and call... I'd never need to find other people to play games with me!

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** You don't need to explain the rest.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** This has "cultivation mishap" written all over it.

##### Shared continuation

**Vesna:** Ahem... It wasn't nearly that serious! There was just a teeny-tiny surplus of spiritual power... Teeny-tiny!

**Vesna:** Then, before I knew it, every last sword spirit had flown the coop. One of them even made off with the second half of my copy of the Ancient Sword Esoterica!

**Paimon:** Ancient Sword Esoterica? Honestly, that name's a little much...

**Vesna:** For the past two days, there have been rumors of a tiny flying thief that appears and vanishes without a trace, snatching up every glittering gem and precious trinket it can find... The moment I heard, I knew one of my sword spirits had to be behind it.

**Paimon:** So that explains everything... But why not send the Druzhna to round them up?

**Vesna:** Because that isn't what the Druzhna is for. We're an elite force under Her Majesty's command.

**Paimon:** ...You were hoping to clean this up quietly before anyone found out you caused it, weren't you?

**Vesna:** Well... that may have been one consideration... But there's no use dwelling on that now! With you two here, I've suddenly got three times the manpower!

- **Traveler:** Hold on. When exactly did we agree to help?

**Vesna:** Don't be like that! Whenever humans run into trouble, they turn to adventurers. It's only natural, isn't it? Besides, my collection is extensive enough that I'm sure I can offer you a reward you'll be more than happy with.

**Vesna:** So, that settles it! Meet me at the Druzhna garrison tomorrow, and we'll work out how to capture the remaining sword spirits. Be sure to show up! I'd rather not have to come looking for you.

**Paimon:** Guess the decision's been made for us...

- **Traveler:** Couldn't get a word in to object if we tried...

**Paimon:** Having the Commander of the Druzhna come after us in person is probably more trouble than it's worth, huh...

**Paimon:** Fine! We'll go tomorrow and hear how she plans to track down the rest of those... sword spirits, or whatever they're called!

#### Go to the Druzhna garrison and talk to Vesna

**Vesna:** "...Spirit, roam the eight reaches! Mind's eye, survey the four quarters! Let all that lies hidden come forth... Reveal yourself!"

**Paimon:** ...

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** ...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** ...What are you doing?

##### Shared continuation

**Vesna:** Hm? I'm using "divine sense" to search for the sword spirits. It's a technique from the Ancient Sword Esoterica.

**Vesna:** Sword Immortals can extend their senses across an entire area and uncover every hidden trace in an instant... Hehe, that would sure come in handy during my Druzhna duties, let me tell you.

**Vesna:** Ooh, and for "taking out the trash." It'd save me a whole lot of nagging from Danica, that's for sure.

**Paimon:** Uh... By "taking out the trash," you mean what Paimon thinks you mean, right?

**Vesna:** Hm? What else would I mean?

**Paimon:** You know what? Never mind... Paimon's probably better off not asking. So you managed to cultivate it then? This "divine sense" thing?

**Vesna:** Well... The important thing is, I've more or less pinpointed where the next sword spirit is. I also modified one of my collectibles into a "Divine Sense Compass." Here, take it.

**Paimon:** Whoa, it's actually pointing somewhere! You really did manage to develop a "divine sense" then!

- **Traveler:** How exactly does this compass work?

**Vesna:** Oh, the principle is very simple. First, I use elemental energy to sense the sword spirit's approximate location... Then I use elemental energy to bend the needle to point in that direction.

**Paimon:** ...

- **Traveler:** ...

**Paimon:** So... this has absolutely nothing to do with "divine sense" at all!?

**Vesna:** Nope. I tried the book's method several times, but it just didn't work. My own power turned out to be much better at sensing the sword spirits.

**Vesna:** But, by the time I realized that, I'd already finished making the compass. It would be a shame if it never got the chance to be useful, wouldn't it?

**Vesna:** Since this is a team effort, I'll give you the honor of holding onto it!

**Paimon:** Fine... But if there was never any "divine sense," then what was all that "Spirit, roam the eight reaches" stuff about?

**Vesna:** Oh, that was just for effect. It sounded impressive, so I thought I'd recite it. Liyue incantations are quite the mouthful, though. I had to practice that one several times! Would you like to give it a try?

**Paimon:** Absolutely not!

#### Find the Sword Spirit

**???:** ...Hahaha! Success! At last, I've done it!

**Paimon:** Whoa! D—Did that sword just talk!?

**???:** What an absurd question! I was born a true sword spirit. Speech is but the simplest of feats for one such as I! Now then, who are you ordinary mortals supposed to—

**???:** M—Master!?

**Vesna:** Born a true sword spirit, were you? Then what does that make me? A pebble on the side of the road?

**???:** Curses... You tracked me down so quickly... Don't get too pleased with yourself, V—Vesna!

**Master of Potions:** I have mastered the supreme art of potioncraft! I gathered rare treasures from across the land and spent three days and three nights refining them into an immortal elixir unlike anything this world has ever seen!

**Vesna:** Hold on... Is that the elixir from the Ancient Sword Esoterica? The one the ancient people of Liyue used to achieve the impossible? You actually managed to make it?

**Master of Potions:** Hmph! A single sip is all it will take! I shall transcend my mortal limits, attain power beyond imagination, and unleash a strike that not even ten of you could withstand!

**Paimon:** ...Uh-huh. And how exactly are you supposed to take a sip when you don't even have a mouth?

**Master of Potions:** Hahaha! Why, that is the simplest part! All I have to do is—

**Master of Potions:** ...

**Master of Potions:** I completely forgot about that part!

**Vesna:** You broke its fighting spirit, Paimon! Nicely done!

**Paimon:** Huh? Paimon did what!?

**Vesna:** Take this!

**Master of Potions:** No...!

**Paimon:** For a sword that talked such a big game, it sure went down like a chump...

**Vesna:** That's the cruel reality of immortal cultivation. Or so the ancient texts claim. Cold and ruthless as a Snezhnayan snowstorm, it's a world where the strong devour the weak...

**Vesna:** One false move, and you lose everything. The person who defeats you not only gets to claim your life, but also anything you leave behind.

- **Traveler:** Like this cauldron?

**Vesna:** Exactly! Which means it's time to enjoy the spoils of victory. Now then, who wants the first taste?

**Paimon:** Uh... definitely not Paimon. That looks like a stomachache waiting to happen...

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** We don't know the first thing about this potion...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Are you really going to try it just like that?

##### Shared continuation

**Vesna:** Aw, don't start sounding like Danica. If you spend your whole life worrying about what might happen, you'll miss out on all the fun! Here, I'll go first.

**Vesna:** ...

**Paimon:** S—So, uh... feel any stronger?

**Vesna:** Mmm... Nope. It's sweet, though.

You join Vesna in finishing the "elixir."
Though surprisingly tasty, it shows no sign of granting anyone extraordinary strength.
Thankfully, it doesn't cause any stomach trouble, either.

**???:** Hmph! That fool and I have nothing in common. It squanders its time seeking power through pills and elixirs, no matter how often I tell it that borrowed strength is no strength at all! The body must be forged! Tempered! Pushed beyond its limits! That is the only path worthy of reaching the heavens!

**Master of Body:** That is why I walk the path of the Master of Body!

**Master of Body:** Although... I will admit the rare treasures we stole together proved rather useful. I used them to create a soul-cleansing elixir capable of washing the marrow and remaking the body from within! All I have to do is immerse myself in it...

**Vesna:** Hmm... Well, that explains the string of strange herb thefts the other day. So you were behind them.

**Vesna:** You know I had to pay for those and apologize on your behalf. That's enough to make someone very angry...

**Master of Body:** You... I... I don't care! I'm going in!

**Master of Body:** Just wait until I emerge from this cauldron...!

- **Traveler:** ...

**Vesna:** Hehe. Looks like we're on the same page... Let's do it.

**Master of Body:** W—Wait... What are you two planning!?

**Vesna:** You wanna stay in this cauldron so bad? Fine, we'll even give you a hand!

**Vesna:** Ooh, great idea!

**Master of Body:** Wait... Wait!

#### Find the Sword Spirit

**???:** "...With the brush, the paths of yin and yang are traced. With ink, the eight directions are brought to heel..."

**???:** "...The sigil takes form, and ghosts and gods retreat! The art awakens, and all evil cowers before it!"

**???:** Mm... Yes. Magnificent! A sigil worthy of the highest praise! In ancient times, mortals painted images of the gods to ward off evil. Today, I shall create a sigil of my own to drive away misfortune.

**Master of Sigils:** Once my Sword Sigil is complete, ghosts will tremble and demons will flee! And best of all, one glance at it should make Master think twice before troubling the great Master of Sigils again! Hahahahaha!

**Paimon:** ...So which "master" are we dealing with this time?

**Vesna:** Oh? Look who's curious now!

**Master of Sigils:** Huh? That voice... Master's here! This is bad. My Sword Sigil is not yet complete... A strategic retreat is in order!

**Master of Sigils:** By my command — vanish!

**Vesna:** Hm? It concealed its presence... Interesting...

**Paimon:** Oh, a portrait? Huh, doesn't it kinda look like...

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** It does seem familiar...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Maybe it was modeled after someone...

##### Shared continuation

**Master of Sigils:** (Hehe... So they recognize the face. Perfect. Run while you still can!)

**Master of Sigils:** (This is my finest work, after all, a likeness etched deep into the memories of sword spirits and Master alike...)

**Master of Sigils:** (The one person Vesna fears more than anyone!)

**Vesna:** ...Hmph. It thinks a cheap little trick like this can scare me? How insulting.

**Vesna:** Hand me that brush! I'll show it what a truly terrifying makeover looks like.

**???:** "Flesh may fail and blood run cold, but steel shall rise where mortals falter."

**???:** "Of all the myriad paths, only one holds the true key — the art mortals call technology!"

**Master of Artifacts:** The Master of Artifacts, at your service!

**Paimon:** ...Are we even talking about cultivation anymore!?

- **Traveler:** ...Are we even talking about cultivation anymore!?

**Master of Artifacts:** Hah! Why should cultivation be shackled by convention? If talismanic concoctions and medicinal elixirs can pave the way to transcendence, then steel and iron may likewise be refined into artifacts.

**Master of Artifacts:** With this mechanical body, I shall defeat Master and prove that the other sword spirits remain confined to an age long past!

**Master of Artifacts:** The theory is sound. Now, let battle provide the proof!

**Vesna:** Sounds good to me. After indulging everyone's little performances these past few days, it's about time we settled things the straightforward way!

#### Defeat the Master of Artifacts

#### Talk to the Sword Spirit

**Master of Artifacts:** How could this be...? I was meant to carry the wisdom of the past into the future... And yet here I stand... defeated.

**Vesna:** Consider yourself lucky you faced me instead of that cat creature — or, um, girl that works under Arlecchino. You probably would've gone down even faster against her.

**Master of Artifacts:** I understand now... All things beneath the heavens have that which sustains them and that which overcomes them... In the end, it was I who failed to account for the greater whole...

With one final, rueful lament, the Master of Artifacts fades into the nothing...

**Vesna:** Whew... Good thing we stopped it in time.

**Vesna:** If that thing had reached the city, we'd have had a Fatui machine rampaging through the streets in broad daylight. Not exactly a good look for any of us.

**Paimon:** Come to think of it, though, plenty of adepti are good with mechanisms.

**Paimon:** So maybe your secret manual was written by one of them?

**Vesna:** Ah... about that. I did look into it, but the trail didn't lead very far.

**Vesna:** Apparently, Yae Publishing House was clearing out some of its stock, so the book seller bought up a whole bunch at once. He never even checked them individually.

**Paimon:** He didn't even think to look through what he was buying!?

- **Traveler:** Guess we have no leads then...

**Vesna:** ...Well, there might be one. I vaguely remember the author leaving a note somewhere in the second half of the book.

**Paimon:** Ooh, that sounds important! What did it say?

**Vesna:** I don't remember... To be honest, I never took a close look at it. I only skimmed a few pages before buying the book.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Anything to keep the price down...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Even if it means buying a book you barely looked through...

##### Shared continuation

**Vesna:** Haha... Once I finally started reading the first half, I kinda just... created the sword spirits as I went...

**Vesna:** Then one of them made off with the entire second half, so...

**Paimon:** So the author's identity will have to remain a mystery for now...

**Vesna:** Hehe. Just give it another day or two. Once all the sword spirits have been captured, we'll have those missing pages back!

**Vesna:** And then we'll finally get our answer!

#### Talk to Vodyanitsa and the rest

**Vodyanitsa:** ...Have you heard the rumors about that strange shadow people keep seeing around the theater?

**Vodyanitsa:** Lately, whenever I rehearse onstage, I can feel someone watching from the corner of the room... But the moment I turn around...

**Vodyanitsa:** No one's there!

**Odette:** Perhaps no one was there to begin with.

**Vodyanitsa:** Honestly, you're no fun! I have a much more romantic theory! It could be the ghost of some lovestruck fan haunting the theater...

**Vodyanitsa:** Waiting until you look away... only to appear right behind you!

**Vesna:** Hi~

**Vodyanitsa:** Eek—!

**Vesna:** Hm? Oh, did I startle you? I suppose sneaking up behind you in the middle of a ghost story was poor timing. Sorry.

**Vodyanitsa:** Don't pretend that wasn't deliberate! I didn't even hear you walk over here!

**Vesna:** That's because I didn't walk. I flew.

**Paimon:** (Yeah... That definitely wasn't an accident...)

**Odette:** It's been a while, Vesna.

**Vesna:** It has. Did I hear you mention something about a "ghost" haunting the theater? Could you tell me more?

**Odette:** I could. Though I'm rather curious as to why the commander of the Druzhna is so interested in a ghost story.

**Vesna:** Hmm... Fine. I suppose I can tell the two of you. We're close to resolving the matter anyway...

Vesna explains the situation...

**Vodyanitsa:** Ah, so that's why the "ghost" felt so peculiar! It wasn't a ghost at all. It was one of your sword spirits!

**Odette:** ...Hardly the romantic explanation you were hoping for.

**Paimon:** So someone really was watching Vodyanitsa... and that someone was a sword spirit hiding somewhere in the theater?

**Paimon:** Huh, if it's like the others we've met, does that mean its area of cultivation is... music?

**Vesna:** Quite possibly. Great heroes in stories always seem to arrive with a song on their lips and an instrument in hand. Hehe... And don't we have two perfect examples standing right here?

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** We've already encountered the Masters of Potions, Body, Sigils, and Artifacts...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** So this one must be the "Master of Sound"?

##### Shared continuation

**Vesna:** From your description, this sword spirit seems far more cautious than the others. It likely won't reveal itself so easily.

**Vodyanitsa:** Yeah... The only times I sensed its "gaze" were while I was performing.

**Odette:** Hm, perhaps that's the reason it decided to hide out in the theater to begin with... to observe our performances.

**Odette:** I'm not quite sure how that relates to its cultivation, but our next rehearsal may provide an opportunity to locate it.

- **Traveler:** We appreciate the help.

**Odette:** Think nothing of it. From what you've told us, the previous sword spirits were all rather... troublesome in their own ways.

**Odette:** The one hiding here hasn't done any harm so far, but I'd rather find it now than wait until something happens.

**Vesna:** Sounds like a plan. I'll prepare for the search. Guess this means I get a front-row seat to watch you rehearse, huh!

**Paimon:** Hey! Don't forget why we're here!

**Vodyanitsa:** ♪~

**Vesna:** Oh oh, it's starting! Vodyanitsa's singing... I haven't heard her perform in ages. She sounds every bit as lovely as I remember!

**Paimon:** Uh... We're here for something else, remember?

**Vesna:** Don't worry, I haven't forgotten. "Let all that lies hidden come forth... Reveal yourself!"

#### Capture the Sword Spirit

**Vodyanitsa:** This little thing is the sword spirit? Aw, it's even cuter than I imagined.

**Paimon:** Huh, it doesn't seem like much of a talker. It kinda reminds Paimon of the one we met on the first day...

**Master of Sound:** ...

**Odette:** Except that one was a thief. This one has behaved impeccably during its time here. It hasn't been a disturbance to us or the audience.

**Vodyanitsa:** Right... And if it truly aspired to become some sort of "Master of Sound," surely it would have shown some interest in the instruments stored backstage. But it hasn't.

**Vodyanitsa:** Perhaps it really did come here just to watch us perform?

**Master of Sound:** ...

**Vesna:** ...Alright, alright. Don't give it too much credit. Its motivations don't really matter. It needs to be refined in the end, just like the others.

**Vesna:** Perhaps, for now, all it wants is to watch a few performances. But once it accumulates as much spiritual power as the others did...

**Vesna:** ...There's no telling whether it will become just as reckless — blind to everything around it. Desire, when left unchecked, has a way of growing beyond one's control.

- **Traveler:** (..."Desire, when left unchecked"?)

**Vesna:** I'm the one who created it. It's only right that I see this through to the end.

**Master of Sound:** ...

**Vesna:** What the—

**???:** "Cold light cuts through endless night! Sword intent soars to heaven's height! Should all beneath the skies bar my way — my blade will sweep them all astray!"

**Greater Sword Spirit:** "If fate dares deny my vow, I'll carve a brand-new path — right now!"

**"Second of the Pack" & "Third of the Pack":** Hyah!

**Master of Sound:** ...?

**Vesna:** H—Hold on...

**Vesna:** Which sword spirit are you supposed to be? The ones that escaped back then were all much smaller than you...
